## Prospective Ph.D. students

I am hiring new Ph.D. students in this year's application cycle. Applications go through the Department of Computer Science's graduate admissions process, with a deadline of December 15. To start your application or learn more about the process, see the department's [Ph.D. admissions page](https://www.cs.jhu.edu/academic-programs/graduate-studies/phd-program/phd-program-admissions/) and its [Ph.D. admissions FAQ](https://www.cs.jhu.edu/academic-programs/graduate-studies/phd-program/phd-admissions-faqs/).
